main_body: snow-covered log cabin with sloped roof and front wall
top_band: white and light blue-grey snow-covered roof slope from row 8 to row 36
evidence: Reading down a middle column: rows 8-36 show the foreshortened sloped roof covered in snow, ending at an overhanging eave edge with icicles (rows 35-36). Rows 37-38 show a dark brown eave shadow directly beneath the roof overhang. Rows 38-60 show the vertical front log wall with a recessed wooden door and windows with snow-capped sills.

style.evidence: The cabin has 5-6 distinct shading tones on both the snow roof (pure white, pale grey-blue, light blue-grey, medium blue-grey, dark slate) and the brown wood logs/door. Outlines use dark brown next to wood and dark slate/navy next to snow/shutters. Rich surface texture with layered snow drifts, icicles, individual log shading, wood grain on the door, and glowing multi-tone window panes.
